[EVENT] The user requested to fit Lake Moraine into their trip summary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lake Moraine is a stunning glacial lake located in Banff National Park, known for its turquoise water and beautiful surroundings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lake Moraine is situated in the Valley of the Ten Peaks, surrounded by towering mountains that reflect beautifully in the water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There are several hiking trails around Lake Moraine, ranging from easy walks to more challenging hikes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors can rent a canoe or kayak to explore Lake Moraine from the water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The only downside to visiting Lake Moraine is that it can get quite crowded during peak tourist season, especially in the summer months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Visiting early in the morning or later in the evening can help avoid crowds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, Lake Moraine is considered worth visiting for its beauty and serenity.
